title: XCUITest Real Devices Testing - TestMu AI (Formerly LambdaTest) Automation
description: Run XCUITest suites on real iPhones and iPads in the TestMu AI cloud. Upload your app and runner, run in parallel, get video and device logs per test.

hero.lede: XCUITest on TestMu AI runs your native iOS UI tests on real iPhones and iPads in the cloud. You upload the app and the XCUITest runner, choose devices and iOS versions, and every test returns a video, device logs and a pass or fail.
hero.note: Real device free plan: 5 sessions a month, up to 2 minutes each.
